visual_requirements.description: Broad term without a single documented bodily form

aura: No generic aura. Presence comes from documented anatomy and action: mazoku-c01, mazoku-c03, mazoku-c04, mazoku-c07, mazoku-c09.
artistic_choices: Declined rather than inventing a composite demon anatomy or borrowing popular fantasy designs.
reason: Klaim mazoku-c01/c03/c04/c07/c09 mendefinisikan istilah payung bagi beragam makhluk; tidak ada anatomi khusus atau manifestasi aktif tunggal yang terdokumentasi. Menggambar tubuh, tanduk, sayap, atau kelompok akan mengarang wujud. Tidak-digambar sesuai GAMBAR §6.5.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
